answer: Registration with Disability Support Services (DSS) applies to the Australian campus. Complete the registration form, which must be signed and dated by a health professional (Part A) and by you (Parts B and C); you can register at any time, but it is a good idea to do so before your units start.

points.text: A relative or family friend cannot complete Part A of the form; it must be a health professional.
points.quote: Part A can’t be completed by a relative or family friend.
points.title: Register for disability services

points.text: You can submit a digital copy or a PDF version of the form.
points.quote: You can submit a digital copy or a PDF version of the form.
points.title: Register for disability services

points.text: If you already have supporting documents from a health professional, you don't need Part A; email DSS with those documents and signed, dated Part C.
points.quote: you don’t need to complete Part A of the registration form – just send an email to DSS with:
points.title: Register for disability services

points.text: Carers can register by asking the health professional treating the person they care for to complete the Carer Registration form; a DSS adviser will then contact you.
points.quote: Ask the qualified health professional (with expertise in the appropriate field) treating the person who you provide care for to complete the Carer Registration form (pdf 350kb).
points.title: Students who are carers
points.section: How to register as a carer

citations.quote: To get started, fill in our registration form and arrange to meet with us.
citations.title: Disability Support Services

citations.quote: The registration form needs to be completed, signed and dated by both a health professional (Part A) and the student seeking registration (Part B and Part C).
citations.title: Register for disability services
